title: ACGS Phase Exit Evidence
$comment: Pack II artifact B3. Governance-process evidence for a ship-loop phase gate; distinct from a gove-zone Decision Receipt. A criterion's `verify_cmd` must be a real command a stranger can run — for gove-zone the audit/receipt verification commands are `gove-zone replay --event <id> --audit <path>`, `gove-zone smoke --audit <path>`, and `gove-zone proofpack` (there is NO `gove-zone verify` subcommand). `ledger_head_hash` is the tail event_hash of a ChainHashAuditStore JSONL chain (sha256, lowercase hex; GENESIS_HASH is 64 zeros).

verify_cmd.description: A command a stranger can run to confirm this criterion. Required in spirit for any criterion claiming a verifiable property.

exit_criteria_met.description: MUST be the logical AND of every exit_criteria[].met. The observer computes it; it is not asserted independently by the executor.

validator_signoff.description: True only when the validator returned PASS with zero open BLOCKER findings.
